Metrics.Name: entra.directory.sync.last_sync_age_seconds
Metrics.Description: Seconds since the on-premises directory last synced to this tenant. Only emitted when on-premises sync is enabled and a last-sync timestamp is available.

Metrics.Name: entra.organization.age_days
Metrics.Description: Age of the Entra tenant in days, from its createdDateTime.

Metrics.Name: entra.organization.info
Metrics.Description: Constant 1 gauge carrying bounded tenant posture (tenant type) as an attribute.

Metrics.Name: entra.organization.on_premises_sync_enabled
Metrics.Description: 1 if the tenant is currently synced from an on-premises directory (hybrid AD Connect/Cloud Sync), else 0.

Metrics.Name: entra.organization.verified_domains.total
Metrics.Description: Total verified domains associated with the tenant.
